title: More reliable capture and notifications
summary: Improved workspace registration for Quick Capture and notifications, with clearer errors and better separation between development and installed builds.

items: Quick Capture verifies its active workspace before enabling the global shortcut, retries temporary registration failures, and repairs the connection when opened.
Workspace changes are registered in order so a delayed startup reset cannot replace a newer active workspace.
Notification setup errors show the underlying reason and clear after a successful retry.
Development builds use separate Windows notification identities and shortcuts, preventing them from overwriting the installed app’s registration.
Development sign-in and notification links use a separate URL scheme. Installed builds restore their own link registration when launched.
Development builds are labelled Scribe Dev in the title bar, tray, Quick Capture and Windows notifications. About identifies development and production builds.
Development Quick Capture defaults to Ctrl + Shift + D, while installed builds keep Ctrl + Shift + Space. New custom shortcut choices are preserved.
Windows startup entries use distinct names for development and installed builds. Existing note and profile storage locations are unchanged.
